fields.title: FocusBuddy
fields.subtitle: AI-Powered Task Decomposition & Executive Function Platform
fields.description: A cognitive-friendly productivity platform that helps students start and sustain momentum by deconstructing overwhelming to-do lists into bite-sized tasks, featuring intelligent single-task focus and integrated overwhelm recovery.

fields.title: HunianQita
fields.subtitle: Integrated & Verified Student Housing Search Platform
fields.description: A centralized accommodation platform that streamlines the rental journey with authenticated listings, smart AI matching, and direct host communication for a reliable finding experience.

fields.title: PacilSync
fields.subtitle: Integrated Academic & Student Life Information Portal
fields.description: A centralized web portal designed to eliminate fragmented campus announcements by aggregating academic schedules, student events, and career opportunities into a unified dashboard, complete with one-click Google Calendar syncing, bookmarking, and deadline alerts.

fields.title: Compfest
fields.subtitle: Brand Identity & Multi-Channel Feed Design
fields.description: Directed visual asset creation and social media feed curation as VPIC of Visual Design. Developed modular design systems and 3D graphic elements, managing inter-divisional creative pipelines to elevate the brand's digital presence and audience engagement.
